@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter simple-table-constructor empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local S=P.SimpleTable
local st=S('a caption',{'AlignLeft','AlignRight'},{.5,0},{{P.Plain'h1'},{P.Plain'h2'}},{{{P.Plain'x'},{P.Plain'y'}}})
  probe('S()', function() return S() end)
  probe('S(nil)', function() return S(nil) end)
  probe('S({})', function() return S({}) end)
  probe('S(123)', function() return S(123) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039)', function() return S('cap') end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{})', function() return S('cap',{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{},{})', function() return S('cap',{},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{},{},{})', function() return S('cap',{},{},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {},{},{})', function() return S('cap',{}, {},{},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{\039Bogus\039}, {},{},{})', function() return S('cap',{'Bogus'}, {},{},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {\039bad\039}, {},{})', function() return S('cap',{}, {'bad'}, {},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {},false,{})', function() return S('cap',{}, {},false,{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {},{},false)', function() return S('cap',{}, {},{},false) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {},{false},{})', function() return S('cap',{}, {},{false},{}) end)
  probe('S(\039cap\039,{}, {},{},{false})', function() return S('cap',{}, {},{},{false}) end)
  probe('fields', function() return st.t, keys(st), P.utils.type(st),getmetatable(st), st.unknown end)
  probe('field types', function() return P.utils.type(st.caption), P.utils.type(st.aligns), P.utils.type(st.widths), P.utils.type(st.headers), P.utils.type(st.headers[1]), P.utils.type(st.rows), P.utils.type(st.rows[1]), P.utils.type(st.rows[1][1]) end)
  probe('record', function() return tostring(st) end)
  probe('equal', function() return S('x',{},{},{},{}) == S('x',{},{},{},{}) end)
  probe('not equal', function() return st == S('',{},{},{},{}),st == P.Str'a' end)
  probe('write cached property', function() local old = st.aligns; st.aligns[1]='AlignCenter'; return st.aligns[1],rawequal(old,st.aligns) end)
  probe('write caption', function() st.caption='new'; return st.caption, tostring(st) end)
  probe('reset caption', function() st.caption=nil; return st.caption end)
  probe('write tag', function() st.t='Table' end)
  probe('write unknown', function() st.extra=1 end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
@@@ filter simple-table-conversion empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end

    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')

local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)

local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())

local function run(document)
local S,U=P.SimpleTable,P.utils
local h=P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell({P.Plain'h'},'AlignDefault',1,2)}}
local body={attr=P.Attr(),row_head_columns=0,
  head={P.Row{P.Cell'h1',P.Cell'h2'}},
  body={P.Row{P.Cell({P.Plain'a'},'AlignDefault',2,1),P.Cell'b'},P.Row{P.Cell'c'}}}
local foot=P.TableFoot{P.Row{P.Cell'd',P.Cell'e'}}
local tbl=P.Table({long={P.Plain'Cap',P.Plain'Second'}},
  {{'AlignLeft',0},{'AlignRight',0.5}},h,{body},foot)
  probe('U.to_simple_table()', function() return U.to_simple_table() end)
  probe('U.to_simple_table(nil)', function() return U.to_simple_table(nil) end)
  probe('U.to_simple_table({})', function() return U.to_simple_table({}) end)
  probe('U.to_simple_table(P.Para\039x\039)', function() return U.to_simple_table(P.Para'x') end)
  probe('U.to_simple_table(tbl)', function() return U.to_simple_table(tbl) end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table()', function() return U.from_simple_table() end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table(nil)', function() return U.from_simple_table(nil) end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table({})', function() return U.from_simple_table({}) end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table(tbl)', function() return U.from_simple_table(tbl) end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table(S(\039\039,{},{},{},{}))', function() return U.from_simple_table(S('',{},{},{},{})) end)
  probe('U.from_simple_table(S(\039cap\039,{\039AlignLeft\039},{-1},{},{}))', function() return U.from_simple_table(S('cap',{'AlignLeft'},{-1},{},{})) end)
  probe('complex table', function() local st=U.to_simple_table(tbl); return st.caption,st.headers,st.rows end)
  probe('with unequal widths', function() return U.from_simple_table(S('cap',{'AlignLeft','AlignRight'},{.5},{},{})) end)
  probe('round trip', function() local t=U.from_simple_table(S('x',{'AlignLeft'},{0},{{P.Plain'h'}},{{{P.Plain'b'}}})); return t==U.from_simple_table(U.to_simple_table(t)) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
